stem:
Read this quotation from paragraph 9.

_Warm underwear in the cedar chest in the spare room when you need it._

Which conclusion is best supported by this quotation?

options.label: A
options.text: Helen expects Andrew to be unhappy with her decision to leave.

options.label: B
options.text: Andrew tends to be a more practical thinker than Helen is.

options.label: C
options.text: Helen considers what Andrew wants before acting on her own desires.

options.label: D
options.text: Andrew is accustomed to relying on Helen to manage his basic needs.
